# NanoScrape

NanoScrape provides lightweight HTTP-only web scraping actors on the Apify platform.
All actors use ~10MB Docker images, 128MB RAM, and datacenter proxies.
Pricing starts at $0.001/SERP. No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## Value proposition
- 10-100x cheaper than browser-based alternatives (Puppeteer, Playwright)
- Go HTTP-only architecture with Chrome TLS fingerprinting
- Agent-ready: MCP integration, structured output schemas, OpenAPI-compatible
- 131+ actors across job boards, directories, marketplaces, social media, enrichment
- Anti-bot resilient: Chrome TLS fingerprinting, warm session pools, automatic IP rotation

## Apify profiles
- https://apify.com/santamaria-automations (131+ actors, established)
- https://apify.com/nanoscrape (new releases)

## Technical architecture
- Language: Go
- TLS: Chrome JA3 + HTTP/2 fingerprinting
- Proxy: Datacenter with warm session pools and automatic IP rotation
- Image size: ~10-12MB (multi-stage Docker build)
- Memory: 128MB (Apify minimum tier)
- Pricing: Pay-per-result via Apify charge API with idempotency keys

## MCP integration
All actors support the Apify MCP server for AI agent integration:
```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/{actor-name}
```
Compatible with Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex.
